name: transcript-rail-icon-seats
description: transcript rail: the full live thought's bulb, compact settled thought's bulb, compact live thought's Loader grid, and notification head's status glyph all seat in one avatar column - above 700px every slot starts at the turn's left edge with its row's text at the content edge and a 10px speaker gap (ToolRow's kind icon composes the same seat box but sits in its tool card's own column, covered by toolrow-failure-badge-corner), and below it every slot leads its line inline with the text one full gutter later; no seat ever escapes the turn's box

mutation.declaration: styles/railseat.module.css: the @media (min-width: 700px) .gutterPull { margin-left: calc(-1 * var(--speaker-gutter)) } shared pull reverted to 0 (one composed source now serves the Loader rail row and the notification head); separately, harness.html: the reproduced .thinkLabel and .compactThinkSummary pulls reverted to 0 one at a time
mutation.note: Verified the shared pull and each reproduced thinking-row pull independently. The shared .gutterPull and .thinkLabel mutations were verified 2026-09-21. On 2026-11-21, reverting .compactThinkSummary's pull to 0 failed the desktop rail-origin assertion naming the compact row (slot.left 34px right of turn.left); restoring it returned the four-row case to PASS. Each row is caught through its own source, so the cross-row comparisons and per-row origin arithmetic both carry the case.
